Upcoming Meetings

The Sherwood Charter School Board of Directors hold monthly meetings either in-person or online through Zoom. These meetings are open to the public, we look forward to seeing all interested parents, community members, and members of the press. An agenda will be posted here prior to each meeting.

The full list of upcoming board meetings is available here. Any changes to the schedule will be posted on this page.

December 10, 2025 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda is available here.

January 21, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda is available here.

Join Zoom Meeting:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/83449518447?pwd=8y3La5VvtEFu1b63kevEACu90LkFZO.1
Meeting ID: 834 4951 8447
Passcode: 72Nejq

February 18, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda will be available soon.

March 18, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda will be available soon.

April 15, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda will be available soon.

May 20, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda will be available soon.

June 17, 2026 – Regular Meeting of the Board, 6:00 pm. Agenda will be available soon.

Meet the Board

Jennifer Standke – Chair
Angie Arpiainen – Vice Chair
Justin Hemp – Secretary
Gina Byers – Facilities and Maintenance
Korrin Fyall – Treasurer
Tara Garcia – HR and Policy

Contact the Board

CLICK HERE if you would like to communicate with the Board via email. We use a master email to ensure correspondences with the Board are made available to all members and are properly archived. Correspondences received within 5 working days of an upcoming Board meeting may not be reviewed until the following meeting. Public records requests will be received by the Board Chair & Secretary, and processed accordingly.

The charter contract can be found here.

Minutes Archive

Published here are minutes from the current school year board meetings. A list of all past Board Meeting minutes can be found in the archive.
